name_en: Kankoro — dried sweet potato simmered soft and mixed with sweetened red bean
summary_ja: 米がとれにくい佐田岬半島で保存食として干したさつまいもを、じっくり炊いて砂糖と小豆を合わせるおやつ。鍋で練り炊く音が名の由来とされ、みかん栽培が盛んになる前の暮らしを伝える。
summary_en: On the rice-poor Sada Misaki peninsula, sweet potato was dried for storage, then this snack simmers it soft and works in sugar and red bean. The name is said to come from the sound of stirring the pot, and the dish recalls life on the peninsula before citrus growing took hold.
source_title: かんころ 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ehime Taruto — a castella roll cake filled with yuzu-scented red bean paste
summary_ja: カステラ生地でこし餡を巻いた松山銘菓。長崎で出会った南蛮菓子を藩主が持ち帰り、柑橘どころらしく餡に柚子を加えて和菓子へつくり変えたと伝わり、断面の渦模様が特徴という。
summary_en: A Matsuyama specialty: a castella sponge rolled around sweet red bean paste. A domain lord is said to have brought the recipe home after encountering a Portuguese-style confection in Nagasaki, then reworked it with yuzu citrus in the filling — a nod to the region's oranges — leaving a spiral pattern in cross-section.
source_title: タルト 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
